label: UniFi U7 Pro XGS
description: UniFi U7 Pro XGS (U7-Pro-XGS) - 1x 10G RJ45. 802.3bt PoE-in; WiFi 7; up to 8.6 Gbps PHY rate; 29 W max.
notes: PoE draw read 2026-11-28 from https://techspecs.ui.com/unifi/wifi/u7-pro-xgs (HTTP 200, 674,582 B): the specification table prints "Power Method: PoE++" and "Max. Power Consumption: 29W". 29 W is that figure and it sits on eth0, the single RJ45 the same table's Networking Interface row names. Until this pass the port carried no poeIn at all, so engine/media.js fell back to its 12.95 W 802.3af class default and the model drew 12.95 W whatever the datasheet said. Nothing in the engine compares a PD's draw with the class its PSE declared, so cabling this AP to an 802.3af port is still accepted; the number changes the budget arithmetic, which is the one thing a PoE lab asks of it.
